documents.title: Wayne-Dalton Installation Instructions and Owner's Manual (TorqueMaster)
documents.evidence: Retailer-hosted product document. Search reports the manual covers the TorqueMaster Plus 9100, 9400 and 9600 as well as the 9400 and 9600, so those are recorded as aliases on one record rather than as six models each holding the same PDF. Two cautions: the aggregators file this under "garage door opener", but the 9100 is a door and TorqueMaster is its counterbalance system, so the title here says door rather than opener; and the file name is a retailer part number, not a Wayne-Dalton document code, so none is recorded. Not fetched - egress blocked.
